entry.name: array.insert
entry.digest: Insert elements into an array object
entry.description: Elements can be inserted at the beginning, the end, or in the middle, based on the index specified (0-based).

arguments.name: index
arguments.description: The index at which to insert elements into incoming arrays. By default, this is 0 (insert before the first element).
